item.title: Harbor wire opening report
item.description: Harbor investigation coverage for the timeline acceptance flow. Inspectors unsealed warehouse ledgers while auditors questioned the customs brokers about missing manifests and forged permits.

item.title: Harbor wire cargo report
item.description: Harbor investigation coverage for the timeline acceptance flow. Freight containers piled beside idle cranes because shipping agents disputed tariffs, insurance premiums and overdue berth rentals.

item.title: Harbor wire strike report
item.description: Harbor investigation coverage for the timeline acceptance flow. Dockworkers picketed terminal gates demanding safer scaffolding, overtime wages, pension guarantees and an independent grievance tribunal.
